reviews.title: SENIORS BEWARE!!!!
reviews.text:
The ads are plentiful and deliberately designed to be difficult to close. You’re looking for a dark blue X on a light blue background and if you miss the center of the X by a fraction of a millimeter, a browser opens up on your device. This is designed to frustrate you enough so that you pay to go ad free. 

If you’re willing to pay to play against computer opponents using an algorithm designed to separate you from your money, then this is the game for you. If you want to keep your money, you either make closing the ads part of your gaming experience or you don’t play at all. Those are pretty much your only options.

If you win enough, your computer opponent will get to the highest level with you almost every time. If you deliberately lose on the first question enough, your computer opponent will lose on the first round. That’s the easiest way to confirm that you’re up against an algorithm and not a real opponent.

reviews.title: The Problem With the Millionaire Vault.
reviews.text: For several years they’ve had the same experts on the millionaire vault. I have almost all of them already maxed out. I’ve even messaged them suggesting they get some new ones. Instead now they are offering some in the daily deals. I will not spend diamonds to buy them. I’d rather buy some of the lifelines. The millionaire vault is already way too expensive to be landing on experts you already have maxed out, and it is a waste of diamonds. Any long time players are probably experiencing the same issue. Please make some much needed changes to the millionaire vault.
